sentences.en: Companies with diversified holdings tend to weather economics shocks better.
sentences.zh: 拥有多样化资产组合的公司通常更能抵御经济冲击。

sentences.en: Algeria, an oil-dependent country, should absolutely have a diversified economy.
sentences.zh: 作为依赖石油的国家，阿尔及利亚绝对应该实现经济多元化。

sentences.en: The best thing Algeria could do is diversify its economy.
sentences.zh: 对阿尔及利亚来说，最好的做法就是使经济多元化。

senses.zh: 使多样化，多样化,进入新的商业领域
